name: pentimento-pdf
description: Bezplatný nástroj pro Windows na úpravy PDF, které bezplatný Adobe Reader neumí.
author: Hrabatko

scripts.pdfjs-assets: node scripts/copy-pdfjs-assets.ts && node scripts/copy-ocr-assets.ts && node scripts/third-party-licenses.ts
scripts.program: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.installer: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win msi
scripts.store: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win appx --config electron-builder.store.yml
scripts.store:screenshots: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/store-screenshots.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.verify: npm run testdata && npm run check && npm test && npm run e2e && npm run installer && npm run store && npm run test:package
